role_extensions.t_junction: one contour ends on, or branches from, a line that continues through: the glyph's main stroke carries the through-line and its side stroke starts/ends the abutting line (abutment/occlusion in the drawing; not proof of a physical intersection)
role_extensions.fold_start: apex where a drapery fold, ridge or crease begins: two strokes diverge from one point, typically one continuing an outer contour or band edge and the other opening the fold's inner edge, with paper between the legs
